content.title: A Hybrid Machine Learning Model for Short-Term Mobile Traffic Forecasting
content.abstract: Today, mobile networks are essential for seamless communication. As mobile subscriber numbers increase, mobile network operators must devise strategies to meet the enormous demand for mobile network resources, such as spectrum. Therefore, the need for an effective prediction mechanism for efficient resource management and planning becomes paramount. To address the challenges of non-linearity, burstiness, and hidden temporal patterns in mobile traffic prediction, this paper develops and evaluates a hybrid machine learning model for short-term forecasting of mobile traffic congestion.
